instruction: Insert the three tubes into the rack one by one.
design: One-task circular-rim geometry pilot. Paired by official layout ID; adaptive rollouts may choose different pixels.

modes.B: Same tools plus up to 32 agent-selected pixels per query, with individual XYZ results and valid fraction
modes.C: Same pixels and back projection as B, plus plane/circle fit, residual and rejection reason

primary_outcome: Official simulator success, reported as count out of two per mode.
diagnostics: Tool calls and geometry-query use, first accepted motion and observed object progress, model time, input/output tokens. Check initial recorded views before interpreting pairs.
infrastructure: Keep failed requests and raw attempts. Exclude confirmed transport failures and retry the same cell with backoff. Budget exhaustion during normal execution is a task failure. One active episode at a time.

verification.frame_probe: Eight selected head-camera pixels from one simulated frame agreed between raw, fit, and the original point projector. This checks the numerical wiring, not semantic rim selection.
limits: Visible-rim identification is left to the agent.
No cross-view fusion or finger-to-link6 conversion.
Two layouts cannot establish a cross-task improvement.
